name: Thai Red Curry Chicken & Broccoli with Sesame Corn on the Cob

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Place oil, curry paste, and soy sauce in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp Thai curry paste, red
2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the sauce.
Add broccoli to the bowl and toss to coat. Divide chicken and broccoli between the baking sheets, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing broccoli and flipping chicken halfway through, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium.
Remove husks and silks from corn.
When the chicken and broccoli are almost done, uncover the pot and use tongs to lower the corn into the water. Cook until just tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, soy sauce, and sesame seeds in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sesame oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken, broccoli, and corn between plates; drizzle corn with sesame oil. Enjoy!
